tasks.title: knacklabs-upgrade-project skill + registration + docs + test
tasks.objective: Add install/claude/knacklabs-upgrade-project/SKILL.md: a runbook that locates the harness robustly (verify origin/ref/clean, halt on pull fail), then audit -> forge upgrade + doctor --fix -> backfill -> guided re-authoring of PENDING stories via forge roadmap fill (never import/done) -> re-verify -> forge next, with every client command using --repo "$TARGET". Register it in setup's loop; update the existing getting-started upgrade section + README/forge.md; add a structure/safety test.
acceptance_criteria: SKILL.md runs the sequence locate(robust)->preflight audit->forge upgrade+doctor --fix->review->project backfill->guided roadmap fill re-authoring->re-verify->forge next; every client command carries --repo "$TARGET" and upgrade is the only step run from $HARNESS.
Re-authoring uses forge roadmap fill (pending-only) and NEVER roadmap import or a done story; the skill is framed periodic/convergent (clean committed baseline before each upgrade cycle).
The skill name is in setup's bootstrap-skill loop (installs to both runtime homes); the existing getting-started 'Upgrading an existing repo' section routes through it (updated, not duplicated).

A test asserts the skill exists, its name + trigger phrases, the {{HARNESS_PATH}} robust-locate strings, --repo "$TARGET" on client commands, forge roadmap fill present and roadmap import absent, and the skill in setup's loop.
verify_commands: uv run --with pytest python -m pytest factory/tests/test_gates.py -q -k "upgrade_project_skill"
tasks.reviewer_focus: The two exactness points: every client command routes --repo "$TARGET" (never the harness), and re-authoring uses roadmap fill NOT import (asserted by the test); robust locate strings present; registered in setup; existing getting-started section updated not duplicated.
